Application Data.NAME: Smith Upholstery Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Upholstery Services specializes in providing high-quality upholstery repair and restoration services for residential and commercial furniture. Our operations include reupholstering sofas, chairs, and other upholstered items, as well as offering custom fabric selection and design consultation. We focus on delivering superior craftsmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring that each piece is treated with care and attention to detail. Our team is experienced in both contemporary and traditional upholstery techniques, catering to a diverse clientele that values quality and style. In addition to our core services, we also offer furniture refinishing and minor repairs to enhance the longevity and appearance of our clients' furnishings.
